Doresain Exalt at AA                           VS                             Gogier Spear at AA

atk*240%                                                                            atk*200%
str Bonus 700%                                                                       Str bonus 700%
Base damage bonus 0/ 50% at OE                                    Base damage bonus 200%

This still not accounted other mechanic like Undertow stack which provide huge amount of Crit dmg and final damage, X cost stack which can ramp up STR bonus to 1900%. 

What I'm trying to say is not that Gogier is too good, but DORESAIN IS TOO WEAK. 

What is the point of using Doresain at this stage ? 

Gather 3 corpse and 200 aliemus for OverExaltation just to deal less damage than 1 card from WARDEN, which can play multiple of times per turn at that ?

Not to mention, Crit damage scaling is the worst for Doresain. You have to thanks god everytime his card dealt crit damage. Unlike Gogier which comfortably hit 100+ crit rate and ton of crit dmg at the same time.


To Summarize:

I play both Doresain AA and Gogier AA lvl in the same team and funny enough, Doresain just got his Dmg carried by warden unit. 

Buff Doresain is not enough, he need his whole kit revamp. Or else the next rewinding item giveaway will be his queue.

And I felt that if some concept of Gogier apply to Doresain, such as Crit rate and corpse stack give more crit dmg/base dmg scaling, he could be saved.
